scripts.text:
- Please stop here!! -
- You have carried too much items, -
- Therefore unable receive any item again, -
- Please reduce your weight, -
- And come back again later! -
scripts.translation:
- 请停在这里！！ -
- 您携带的物品太多了， -
- 因此无法再接收任何物品， -
- 请减轻负重， -
- 稍后再来！ -

scripts.text:
[Designer Heidam]
I am Designer Heidam, who has all kinds of cool costumes in the World.
If you have any Kitcoins with you, come look for Designer Heidam!
scripts.translation:
[设计师 海丹]
我是设计师海丹，拥有世界上各种酷炫的服装。
如果您身上有Kitcoin，请来找设计师海丹！

scripts.text: Exchange costume for random enchant box
scripts.translation: 用服装兑换随机附魔盒

scripts.text: Continue conversation
scripts.translation: 继续对话

scripts.text:
[Designer Heidam]
Though I look out of shape right now, I used to be a well known fashion model and designer!
scripts.translation:
[设计师 海丹]
虽然我现在的样子有点走样，但我曾经是著名的时装模特和设计师！

scripts.text:
[Designer Heidam]
Don't pity me! I am well aware of my looks, but I like who I am inside.
scripts.translation:
[设计师 海丹]
别同情我！我很清楚自己的外表，但我喜欢内在的自己。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This item is useless to me! Do you have anything else?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这件物品对我没用！你还有别的吗？

scripts.text:
[Designer Heidam]
Oh, then I can exchange it for a box of costume enchantment items.
scripts.translation:
[设计师 海丹]
哦，那我可以用它兑换一个服装附魔物品盒。

scripts.text: - Rummaging -
scripts.translation: - 翻找中 -

scripts.text:
[Designer Heidam]
I see that you have a ^3131FF{0}^000000. Do you want to exchange this for a costume enchantment box?
scripts.translation:
[设计师 海丹]
我看到你有一个^3131FF{0}^000000。你想用它兑换一个服装附魔盒吗？

scripts.text: Exchange
scripts.translation: 兑换

scripts.text: Look for something else
scripts.translation: 找点别的

scripts.text: Stop Exchanging
scripts.translation: 停止兑换

scripts.text:
[Designer Heidam]
Oh~ Something suddenly disappeared...
Let me check you for another item to exchange...
scripts.translation:
[设计师 海丹]
哦~ 什么东西突然不见了...
让我再检查一下你有没有其他可以兑换的物品...

scripts.text:
[Designer Heidam]
Exchange Completed.
Let me check you for another item to exchange...
scripts.translation:
[设计师 海丹]
兑换完成。
让我再检查一下你有没有其他可以兑换的物品...

scripts.text:
[Designer Heidam]
Meow? Where are you going?
scripts.translation:
[设计师 海丹]
喵？你要去哪里？

scripts.text:
[Designer Heidam]
Guess that is all.
scripts.translation:
[设计师 海丹]
看来就这些了。

scripts.text: Look more
scripts.translation: 再看看

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Designer Heidam]
Bye~
scripts.translation:
[设计师 海丹]
再见~

scripts.text:
[Aver De Dosh]
Welcome to Fashion Stone!!
scripts.translation:
[阿维尔·德·多什]
欢迎光临时尚石！！

scripts.text:
[Aver De Dosh]
We take various costume items.
scripts.translation:
[阿维尔·德·多什]
我们回收各种服装物品。

scripts.text:
[Aver De Dosh]
If you want cool styling for your costume, please come to me 'Aver De Dosh'!
Don't forget to bring ^ff0000your own costume and costume stones^000000~
scripts.translation:
[阿维尔·德·多什]
如果您想要酷炫的服装造型，请来找“阿维尔·德·多什”！
别忘了带上^ff0000您自己的服装和服装石^000000~

scripts.text: Apply enchant.
scripts.translation: 进行附魔

scripts.text: End Conversation.
scripts.translation: 结束对话。

scripts.text:
[Aver De Dosh]
Please check our other upgrading services~
scripts.translation:
[阿维尔·德·多什]
请查看我们的其他升级服务~

scripts.text:
[Aver De Dosh]
Kiaaaaach!!!
I hate bulging bags!
No matter how cool your costume looks, that fat bag of yours is a fashion terror you know!
scripts.translation:
[阿维尔·德·多什]
天哪！！！
我讨厌鼓鼓囊囊的背包！
不管你的服装多酷，那个胖乎乎的背包绝对是时尚灾难，你知道吗！

scripts.text:
[Aver De Dosh]
It seems you have too many items on you.
Come back after clearing some inventory space.
scripts.translation:
[阿维尔·德·多什]
看来你身上的物品太多了。
请清理一些背包空间后再来。

scripts.text:
[Aver De Dosh]
You must wear the costume you want to enchant.
Then, I will be able to help you out.
scripts.translation:
[阿维尔·德·多什]
你必须穿上想要附魔的服装。
这样我才能帮你。

scripts.text:
[Aver De Dosh]
Well...
This costume is currently not available for an upgrade.
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Lace La Zard]
Welcome to Fashion Stone!!
My name is Lace La Zard who will make your 'Power Shoulder' dream come true.
scripts.translation:

我是蕾丝·拉·扎德，我将帮你实现“强力肩膀”的梦想。

Bring your ^ff0000Costume Garment^000000 and ^ff0000Garment Stone^000000, I will complete the perfect upgrade for you.!
I found this formula while working on my own humble body upgrading!

带上你的 ^ff0000服装^000000 和 ^ff0000服装石^000000，我会为你完成完美的升级！
这是我研究自己身体升级时发现的配方！
